name: remediation-plan
title: Accessibility remediation plan
for_each: select id,code,name from sites order by code

sections.title: Site and scope
sections.sql: select code,name,standard,jurisdiction,review_on from sites where id=$1

sections.title: Actions to assign
sections.sql: select code,title,criterion,owner,due_on,state from v_findings where site_id=$1 and state<>'resolved' order by code
sections.note: Local priorities and dates. Acceptance of a risk is not a finding that the site conforms.

name: review-evidence
title: Accessibility review evidence
for_each: select id,code,name from sites order by code

sections.title: Audit scope
sections.sql: select code,name,scope,method,assessor,completed_on,evidence from audits where site_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Fix and retest evidence
sections.sql: select code,title,fixed_by,fix_evidence,tested_by,test_method,test_evidence,state from v_findings where site_id=$1 order by code

name: exception-register
title: Accessibility exception register
for_each: select id,code,name from sites order by code

sections.title: Risk decisions
sections.sql: select f.code,f.title,e.actor,e.reason,e.evidence,e.expires_on,e.revoked_at,f.state from exceptions e join v_findings f on f.id=e.finding_id where f.site_id=$1 order by e.sequence
sections.note: Internal decisions only. These are not exemptions from accessibility law.
